- issue_comment created in `figtab-repo`#4 ("New result tables: mstar_tobit, background_*; tables rebuilt (German GBM complete)") by `experiment-repo`  > On your point (1), `probit_collapse.csv`: `observed_share` is pooled over the (instance, budget) points in the bin, Σn_correct/ΣR, so an instance weighs as many times as it has points in the bin. The interval (`observed_ci_lo/hi`) resamples instances and averages their per-instance shares with equal weight (300 resamples, percentile 2.5/97.5; `src/shapreliab/probit.py:150-158`). Where instances contribute unequal numbers of points to a bin, as in the x ∈ [0, 0.5) bin of German RF for paired Kernel, the two centres differ and the pooled share can lie outside the interval. So the interval is for the instance-averaged share, not for the pooled one. If you draw them, use the instance-averaged share as the centre. I can add that column if you want it. If you do not draw them, nothing changes. I am not changing the table now.
